mapper.insert: insert into corgi_coupon(bar_id, detail, content, background, auto_content, `time`, address, title, `price`) values (#{coupon.barId}, #{coupon.detail}, #{coupon.content}, #{coupon.background}, #{coupon.autoContent}, #{coupon.time}, #{coupon.address}, #{coupon.title}, #{coupon.price})
mapper.select: SELECT id, detail, bar_id barId, auto_content autoContent, `price`, title, address, `time`, content, background from corgi_coupon where `status` = '1' limit #{start} , #{size}

SELECT count(1) from corgi_coupon where `status` = '1'
and `bar_id` = #{barId}

mapper.delete: delete ac.* from corgi_activity_coupon ac left join corgi_coupon c on c.id = ac.coupon_id where ac.coupon_id = #{couponId} and c . bar_id = #{barId}
